Skylands Capital Llc bought 24,100 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.21% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Charles Paquelet held 62,100 shares of the investment bankers and brokers and service company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.38 million, up from 38,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Skylands Capital Llc who had been investing in Intercontinental Exchange In for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $40.81 billion market cap company. (NYSE:ICE) has risen 20.88% since May 6, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.33% the S&P500.
